name: Multi-head attention
change: Every query head has its own key and value head, so the cache stores K and V for all heads in every layer.
problem_solved: Lets each head attend to different positions and relations in parallel, replacing recurrence with attention over the whole context.
trade_off: KV cache grows with layers x heads x head_dim per token; decoding becomes memory-bandwidth bound at long context.
kv_formula: 2 × L × H × d_head × b per token
